title: Preserve complete stop measurements across fresh-fix restarts
head: fix/recover-fresh-stop-restarts
body:
A collector restart during a fresh GPS fix could split an ongoing stop and train on only the final fragment. In the recorded Red #316 case, the stored stand was 30seconds while continuous processing measures 439seconds.

Recover the complete detector and visit state from a causal raw prefix only when it matches a still-open recorded arrival. Preserve pending shuffle/departure evidence, reconcile tracking keys first, and process only the new observation for persistence. Existing historical rows remain intact.

Validation: 147 recorded GPS observations; exact continuous/restarted visit equality; departure, stale/gap/identity and contended-name regressions; real SQLite collector records one full visit and one arrival. 2,724 tests across 121 files and server/web TypeScript checks pass. Independent reviewer checked the reconstruction and tracking-key ordering.
